headline: RALPH LOOP WEDGE diagnosed + hardened. 'Ralph isn't firing' was NOT a dead trigger — every label/push fires the workflow, but the single-flight guard in .github/workflows/ralph.yml skips whenever any ralph/* PR is open, and TWO are stuck: #114 (ralph/issue-99, bot) has ralph-gate=failure (AI reviewer named a real defect — the #99 reconcile mass-soft-deletes the board if listOpenIssues() returns a truncated/empty page; Ralph never loops back to fix its own review), and #95 (ralph/issue-69-dom-node-budgets, human, stale base, no gate status). 19 ralph-ready issues stuck behind them, and the skip pinged nobody (Discord only fired on non-skip runs) so the wedge was silent. FIX on claude/ralph-firing-issue-xqwpf9: guard now classifies each open Ralph PR by its latest ralph-gate status (failure OR none/pending≥3h = WEDGED; fresh pending = healthy in-flight quiet skip), sets wedged/reason outputs, and a new Alert-Discord step pings loudly naming the blocking PRs + the fix. Single-flight preserved. Smoke-tested against #114/#95/fresh fixtures (2 wedged, 1 quiet); YAML validated. Immediate unblock (clear #114/#95) = Adrian's operational call. PREVIOUS: Tasks board reworked (Adrian design pass) — cleaner Issues-style cards: [checkbox] #N title↗ · status/tier/tags badges · repo · updated <rel> · copy # · Done · Dispatch · ⋯ overflow (Auto/Queue/Trash moved off the card into a labeled menu). Approvals tile removed from the launchpad; queued count now badges the Tasks tile (route + Queue action kept). #52 DONE — issues+tasks consolidated into ONE board: /ops/tasks is now the single board over every task + GitHub issue across all fleet repos; /ops/issues retired (route -> Navigate to /ops/tasks; IssuesPage/useIssues + api/issues.ts deleted -> api fns 11->10). Multi-select Copy-refs ported onto the tasks board (the one thing /ops/issues did that tasks didn't). Both surfaces always used the same cross-repo listOpenIssues feed, so this removes a redundant view, not a capability. Follow-ups left: importer doesn't yet mark tasks done when their issue closes; source_url vs dispatch_url still conflated. Verified: typecheck/typecheck:api clean, route-coverage 14, build green, layout 16/16, vitest 439/439. Per Adrian's directive, turned all 59 text-only rows into/onto issues: FILED 24 new — ops#62 (EPIC Dashboard command-center, folds in 19 dashboard/skill-bar rows, parked under freeze), ops#63-#75 (13: CI-honesty gates/OWASP/OSV, scripts-prune, guardrails, atlas-docs, codeburn spec, jsdoc, visual-diff gallery, 2 needs-scoping), concrete#8-#10, portfolio#11-#17; MAPPED/deduped the rest — 10 hds rows onto the FROZEN hds#80 epic (don't file into a frozen repo), concrete legal/content→concrete#5/#6, agentic-review-loop→Fleet#41, 3 concrete done/obsolete, grc-career closed off-tracker. Added concrete+portfolio repos to session. Caveat (pre-existing, unfixed): 49 of the 115 github:* rows point at 404 repos (job-hunt/lilac-insure/lilac-bonds/veteran-resource-navigator). EARLIER TODAY: file-now wave reconciled to 0 new issues (bugs already CLOSED #25/#26), Issues+Tasks launchpad tiles merged (#52 slice); combing plan + EXECUTED record at docs/ai/board-comb-2026-07.md. PREVIOUS: Issue #44 landed — auto-record preview_url on leads (scripts/sync-preview-urls.mjs). Pure matchPreviewUpdates(projects, leads) pairs each Vercel project with a READY preview deployment (read via lib/projects listProjects) to a lead by config.slug (hirobius- prefix stripped), then --apply stamps preview_url + status='rendered' via updateLead — the same write the manual 'render' action makes, so a deployed site self-registers as the clickable link in /ops Leads with zero manual paste. Dry-run default, fill-only/idempotent (skips leads that already have a URL), preview-only (production/live_url deliberately out of scope), fail-soft without VERCEL_TOKEN, notify+run-log per record. 13 new unit tests; typecheck/typecheck:api/lint 0-0/vitest 438-438 all green; api/*.ts stays 11/12. Intended to run in the mayor Routine alongside fleet-dispatch.mjs (not yet wired to a live schedule). Closes the manual-paste nav gap from the first-lead→preview session.
